diagnosis: The handler accesses ticket.service_org.staff_members via relationship traversal without checking whether ticket.creator_id == current_user.id or whether the user belongs to the ticket's client organization. An attacker can probe arbitrary ticket_id values to harvest internal support staff names, direct phone extensions, and work emails.
